summary: Frontend-only testing of Raystrat Systems Next.js landing page. Ran 41 UI checks covering hero, all sections, desktop nav anchor scrolling, hero CTAs, footer links, contact form validation (empty + invalid email), contact form preview-only status (honest message, no false success), mobile menu toggle with aria-expanded, and horizontal overflow at 1920 and 390. All 41 checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactForm status message is correctly honest ('has not been sent or stored anywhere yet') and only shows on valid submit — meets the critical acceptance criterion.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes. Good accessibility: aria-required, aria-invalid, aria-describedby, aria-live=polite on status region, aria-expanded on menu toggle.
No backend and no .env in /app/frontend as expected (static marketing site). Backend supervisor is intentionally down — ignored per request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static Next.js landing page tested via preview URL. Backend supervisor intentionally FATAL — do not try to fix. Contact form is preview-only; must never claim successful submission. All 41 UI/anchor/validation/mobile-menu/overflow assertions passed on first run.
